verdict.rationale: Mercury's own launch post says a full accounting API is coming 'soon', so no public Books API is documented as shipping today. Probes for OpenAPI specs and llms.txt all returned 404. The programmatic invoicing claim belongs to the separate Mercury invoicing product, not to driving Books, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
